name: The Fool
upright: beginnings, innocence, spontaneity, a leap of faith
uprightText: A fresh start is calling. Trust the journey and step forward with an open heart.
reversedText: You may be leaping without looking, or holding back from a start you need to make.

name: The Magician
uprightText: You have every tool you need. Focus your intent and turn ideas into action.
reversedText: Your power is scattered or misused. Check your motives and gather your skills before acting.

name: The High Priestess
uprightText: Be still and listen inward. You already know the answer, even if you haven't said it yet.
reversedText: You're tuning out your inner voice, or something is being kept hidden. Make time for quiet.

name: The Empress
uprightText: Growth comes through care. Nourish yourself, your work and the people around you.
reversedText: You've been giving more than you receive. Tend to your own needs so creativity can return.

name: The Emperor
uprightText: Bring order to the chaos. Clear rules and steady leadership will carry you forward.
reversedText: Control has turned into stubbornness, or structure is missing entirely. Find the balance.

name: The Hierophant
uprightText: Lean on proven paths and wise teachers. There's value in doing things the established way.
reversedText: It may be time to break from convention and trust your own way of doing things.

name: The Lovers
uprightText: A bond or decision rooted in your true values. Choose with your heart and your principles.
reversedText: Something is out of alignment in a relationship or a choice. Be honest about what you want.

name: The Chariot
uprightText: Drive forward with focus. Harness opposing forces and you will reach your goal.
reversed: lack of direction, scattered energy, obstacles
reversedText: You're pulled in too many directions. Take back the reins before pushing ahead.

name: Strength
uprightText: Gentle persistence beats force. Meet challenges with a calm heart and quiet confidence.
reversedText: Your confidence is shaken. Be kind to yourself and rebuild your strength slowly.

name: The Hermit
uprightText: Step back from the noise. Time alone will light the way forward.
reversedText: Solitude has turned into isolation. Reach out, or come back from the retreat.

name: Wheel of Fortune
uprightText: The wheel is turning in your favour. Embrace change; what goes around comes around.
reversedText: A downturn, or a cycle repeating itself. Let go of what you can't control and adapt.

name: Justice
upright: fairness, truth, cause and effect, accountability
uprightText: Actions have consequences. Be honest and fair, and the outcome will be just.
reversedText: Something is unbalanced or untrue. Own your part and set the record straight.

name: The Hanged Man
upright: surrender, pause, new perspective, letting go
uprightText: Stop struggling and wait. Seeing things from a different angle shows you the way.
reversedText: You're stuck because you won't let go. Make the decision you've been putting off.

name: Death
uprightText: Rarely literal: something is ending so that something new can begin. Let it go.
reversed: resisting change, stagnation, fear of endings
reversedText: Holding on to what's already over keeps you stuck. Allow the transition.

name: Temperance
uprightText: Blend opposites, take the middle path and let things unfold at their own pace.
reversedText: Too much of something is throwing you off. Slow down and restore the balance.

name: The Devil
uprightText: Notice what binds you: habits, fears or desires. The chains are looser than they look.
reversedText: You're seeing through what held you back. Now is the moment to break free.

name: The Tower
uprightText: Something built on shaky ground falls. It's jarring, but it clears space for the truth.
reversed: averted disaster, fear of change, delaying the inevitable
reversedText: You may be resisting a needed shake-up. A small change now prevents a bigger one later.

name: The Star
uprightText: After the storm comes healing. Have faith; you're on the right path.
reversedText: Hope feels far away. Reconnect with what inspires you and trust that it will return.

name: The Moon
uprightText: Not everything is as it seems. Trust your intuition while the path is unclear.
reversed: clarity returning, fear released, truth revealed
reversedText: The fog is lifting. Confusion fades and hidden things come to light.

name: The Sun
uprightText: A bright day. Warmth, success and confidence shine on everything you do.
reversedText: The sun is behind a cloud, not gone. Find the small joys and keep going.

name: Judgement
uprightText: A call to rise. Look honestly at the past and step into a new chapter.
reversed: self-doubt, harsh self-judgement, ignoring the call
reversedText: You're judging yourself too harshly or avoiding a wake-up call. Forgive yourself and listen.

name: The World
uprightText: A cycle comes to a fulfilling close. Celebrate how far you've come.
reversed: unfinished business, delays, lack of closure
reversedText: You're close, but not done. Tie up loose ends before moving on.

name: Ace of Wands
uprightText: A burst of energy and a new idea. Act on it while the spark is hot.
reversedText: The spark is there but keeps stalling. Find out what's draining your drive.

name: Two of Wands
uprightText: The world is in your hands. Plan your next move and look beyond the familiar.
reversed: fear of the unknown, poor planning
reversedText: You're playing it too safe. Leaving your comfort zone is part of the plan.

name: Three of Wands
uprightText: Your ships are coming in. The effort is paying off, so think bigger.
reversedText: Progress is slower than you hoped. Revisit the plan instead of giving up.

name: Four of Wands
uprightText: A time to celebrate milestones with the people who matter.
reversedText: Things feel unsettled at home or in your circle. Look for common ground.

name: Five of Wands
uprightText: Clashing egos and friction. Healthy competition can sharpen you, but pick your battles.
reversedText: Tension is easing, or being dodged. Talk it out rather than letting it simmer.

name: Six of Wands
uprightText: A public win and well-earned recognition. Enjoy it.
reversed: ego, fall from grace, no recognition
reversedText: Credit isn't coming, or pride is getting in the way. Stay grounded.

name: Seven of Wands
uprightText: You have the high ground. Hold your position and defend what matters.
reversedText: You're worn down defending everything. Choose what's worth fighting for.

name: Eight of Wands
uprightText: Things move fast now. Messages arrive and plans take off, so keep up.
reversedText: Momentum has stalled. Be patient and don't force what isn't ready.

name: Nine of Wands
uprightText: You're tired, but nearly there. One more push.
reversedText: You're running on empty. Rest, and let your guard down a little.

name: Ten of Wands
uprightText: You're carrying too much. Success came with a heavy load, so share it.
reversedText: Time to put some of the weight down. Not everything is yours to carry.

name: Page of Wands
uprightText: Curious, eager energy. A new interest or message sparks excitement.
reversedText: Lots of ideas, little follow-through. Pick one and start.

name: Knight of Wands
uprightText: Charging ahead with fire and confidence. Bold action brings progress.
reversedText: Rushing in without a plan. Channel the energy before it burns out.

name: Queen of Wands
uprightText: Radiant and self-assured. Own your space and lead with warmth.
reversedText: Self-doubt is dimming your light. Reconnect with what makes you confident.

name: King of Wands
uprightText: A visionary leader. Take charge and inspire others with your plans.
reversedText: Leading by force or expecting too much. Listen as well as lead.

name: Ace of Cups
uprightText: An overflowing heart. Open yourself to love, kindness and new connections.
reversedText: Feelings are bottled up. Let them flow, starting with kindness toward yourself.

name: Two of Cups
uprightText: A meaningful connection built on mutual respect, in love or friendship.
reversedText: A relationship feels one-sided. An honest conversation can restore the balance.

name: Three of Cups
uprightText: Raise a glass with friends. Joy is better shared.
reversedText: Too much partying, or feeling left out. Check in on your real friendships.

name: Four of Cups
uprightText: Bored or withdrawn, you may be overlooking what's being offered. Look up.
reversedText: You're coming out of a slump and ready to say yes again.

name: Five of Cups
uprightText: You're focused on what spilled. Grieve it, then notice what's still standing.
reversedText: You're making peace with the past and starting to move on.

name: Six of Cups
uprightText: Fond memories and simple kindness. Reconnect with someone from your past.
reversed: living in the past, rose-tinted memories
reversedText: Nostalgia is holding you back. Honour the past, but live in the present.

name: Seven of Cups
uprightText: Many options, not all of them real. Look closely before you choose.
reversedText: The illusions fade and you can see which path is real.

name: Eight of Cups
uprightText: Time to leave what no longer fulfils you, even if it looks fine from outside.
reversed: fear of change, staying too long, drifting
reversedText: You know it's time to go but keep hesitating. What's keeping you there?

name: Nine of Cups
uprightText: The wish card. Enjoy what you have; what you want is within reach.
reversedText: Getting what you wanted didn't satisfy you. Look for something deeper.

name: Ten of Cups
uprightText: Lasting happiness and loving bonds. Home is where the heart is.
reversedText: Harmony at home is strained. Reconnect over what you all value.

name: Page of Cups
uprightText: A sweet surprise or a creative idea. Stay open to the unexpected.
reversedText: Feelings are running young or getting stuck. Give your inner child some care.

name: Knight of Cups
uprightText: An offer that moves the heart. Follow your feelings with grace.
reversedText: Daydreaming more than doing. Ground your ideals in reality.

name: Queen of Cups
uprightText: Lead with empathy. Your calm presence and intuition support the people around you.
reversedText: You're absorbing everyone's feelings. Set boundaries and care for yourself.

name: King of Cups
uprightText: Calm in the storm. Steady emotions and wise compassion guide your choices.
reversedText: Emotions are being suppressed or used as leverage. Be honest about how you feel.

name: Ace of Swords
uprightText: A moment of mental clarity cuts through the confusion. Speak the truth.
reversedText: Your thoughts are clouded. Get the facts before you decide.

name: Two of Swords
uprightText: Blindfolded between two options. You can't avoid the choice forever.
reversed: information overload, lesser of two evils
reversedText: Overthinking is paralysing you. Take off the blindfold and choose.

name: Three of Swords
uprightText: A painful truth or loss. Let yourself feel it; that's how it heals.
reversedText: The worst of the hurt is passing. Begin to let go.

name: Four of Swords
uprightText: Retreat and recharge. A pause now restores your strength.
reversedText: You need rest but keep pushing, or you've rested too long. Find the middle.

name: Five of Swords
upright: conflict, defeat, winning at all costs
uprightText: A hollow victory. Ask whether being right is worth what it costs.
reversedText: You're ready to end the fight. Apologise, or simply walk away.

name: Six of Swords
uprightText: Leaving troubled waters for calmer shores. The journey itself is healing.
reversedText: You can't move on until you face what's been left behind.

name: Seven of Swords
uprightText: Someone, maybe you, is being sneaky. Be strategic, but stay honest.
reversedText: Secrets come out. Honesty now saves trouble later.

name: Eight of Swords
uprightText: You feel trapped, but the bonds are loose. The way out begins in your mind.
reversedText: You're seeing a way out. Take the first step toward freedom.

name: Nine of Swords
uprightText: Worries loom largest at night. Most fears are worse in your head than in reality.
reversedText: The anxiety is lifting. Share your worries; they shrink when spoken.

name: Ten of Swords
uprightText: It's over and it hurts, but rock bottom is solid ground to rebuild on.
reversed: recovery, regeneration, the worst is over
reversedText: The worst has passed. Get up slowly; healing has started.

name: Page of Swords
uprightText: Sharp and eager to learn. Ask questions and speak your mind.
reversedText: Words before thought. Check your facts and your tone.

name: Knight of Swords
uprightText: Charging toward the goal at full speed. Decisive action wins.
reversedText: Rushing in with sharp words. Slow down and think it through.

name: Queen of Swords
uprightText: Clear-headed and direct. Speak your truth with honesty and fairness.
reversedText: Sharpness has turned into cruelty. Soften without losing your honesty.

name: King of Swords
uprightText: Lead with logic and integrity. Make the fair, rational call.
reversedText: Intellect is being used to control. Make sure your reasoning is fair.

name: Ace of Pentacles
uprightText: A seed of opportunity in money, work or health. Plant it well.
reversedText: An opportunity slips away or isn't on solid ground. Check the details.

name: Two of Pentacles
uprightText: Juggling many things at once. Keep your rhythm and stay flexible.
reversedText: Too many balls in the air. Drop what doesn't matter.

name: Three of Pentacles
uprightText: Good work comes from collaboration. Your skills are being recognised.
reversedText: The team isn't pulling together. Clarify roles and goals.

name: Four of Pentacles
uprightText: Holding tight to what you have. Security matters, but don't grip too hard.
reversedText: You're either clinging too tightly or spending too freely. Find the middle.

name: Five of Pentacles
uprightText: A hard time, materially or emotionally. Help is closer than you think, so ask.
reversedText: Things are getting better. Accept the help on offer.

name: Six of Pentacles
uprightText: Give and receive freely. Share your resources with others.
reversedText: Check the balance of giving. Is help coming with conditions?

name: Seven of Pentacles
uprightText: Your work is growing. Be patient and take stock before the harvest.
reversedText: The effort isn't paying off yet. Rethink where you invest your energy.

name: Eight of Pentacles
uprightText: Head down, perfecting your craft. Steady practice leads to mastery.
reversed: perfectionism, lack of focus, uninspired work
reversedText: Going through the motions, or obsessing over details. Remember why it matters.

name: Nine of Pentacles
uprightText: Enjoy the fruits of your labour. You've earned this comfort.
reversedText: Working too hard to enjoy it, or living beyond your means. Rebalance.

name: Ten of Pentacles
uprightText: Lasting security and a legacy to share. Think long-term.
reversedText: Money or family tension threatens stability. Protect what matters.

name: Page of Pentacles
uprightText: A practical new start or course of study. Be diligent and curious.
reversed: procrastination, lack of progress, missed lessons
reversedText: Big plans, little follow-through. Take one practical step today.

name: Knight of Pentacles
uprightText: Slow and steady wins. Consistent effort gets the job done.
reversedText: Routine has become a rut. Shake things up a little.

name: Queen of Pentacles
uprightText: Warm and grounded. Care for home, body and finances with practical wisdom.
reversedText: You're looking after everyone but yourself. Tend to your own comfort.

name: King of Pentacles
uprightText: Material success through discipline. You're a steady provider.
reversedText: Money or status is taking over. Remember what wealth is for.
